content:
TABLE: customers

DESCRIPTION:
Stores information about customers who purchase products.

COLUMNS:
- customer_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for a customer. Primary key.
- name (VARCHAR(100)): Full name of the customer.
- city (VARCHAR(80)): City where the customer is located.
- state (VARCHAR(80)): State where the customer is located.
- signup_date (DATE): Date when the customer registered.

SAMPLE VALUES:
- name: Manish Mehta, Manish Das, Riya Singh
- city: Dibrugarh, Guwahati, Silchar
- state: Assam, Bihar, Chandigarh
- signup_date: 2021-02-21, 2021-10-13, 2026-01-02

RELATIONSHIPS:
- customers.customer_id ← orders.customer_id

TABLE: order_items

DESCRIPTION:
Stores individual products contained within each order.

COLUMNS:
- order_item_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for an order item. Primary key.
- order_id (INTEGER): Order containing this item.
- product_id (INTEGER): Product contained in the order.
- quantity (INTEGER): Number of units purchased.
- unit_price (DECIMAL(12, 2)): Price of one unit at the time of purchase.

SAMPLE VALUES:
- quantity: 1, 2, 3
- unit_price: 1876.18, 312.28, 99.93

RELATIONSHIPS:
- order_items.product_id → products.product_id
- order_items.order_id → orders.order_id

TABLE: orders

DESCRIPTION:
Stores orders placed by customers.

COLUMNS:
- order_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for an order. Primary key.
- customer_id (INTEGER): Customer who placed the order.
- order_date (DATE): Date when the order was placed.
- status (VARCHAR(30)): Current status of the order.

SAMPLE VALUES:
- order_date: 2023-01-02, 2023-01-03, 2023-01-04
- status: Delivered, Shipped, Cancelled

RELATIONSHIPS:
- orders.order_id ← order_items.order_id
- orders.customer_id → customers.customer_id

TABLE: products

DESCRIPTION:
Stores information about products available for purchase.

COLUMNS:
- product_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for a product. Primary key.
- product_name (VARCHAR(150)): Name of the product.
- category (VARCHAR(80)): Category the product belongs to.
- price (DECIMAL(12, 2)): Current listed price of the product.

SAMPLE VALUES:
- product_name: Oats 0001, Jacket 0002, Coffee 0003
- category: Beauty, Books, Computers
- price: 955.72, 1014.9, 842.01

RELATIONSHIPS:
- products.product_id ← order_items.product_id
